title: Tagaru Palya
desc: After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.

title: Sitaare Zameen Par
desc: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.

title: Rudra Avatar
desc: When a judge's decapitated body is found outside his residence, retired ACP Pon Manickavel helps the police investigate the case in order to catch the culprit.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.

title: Robinhood
desc: A modern-day Robin Hood thrives on stealing from the rich. However, he reluctantly becomes a bodyguard for a high-profile client due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Action
desc: An army colonel is on a mission to catch the mastermind behind a terror attack. However, it gets complicated when he discovers that the terrorists are planning a political upheaval in India.

title: Officer On Duty
desc: A demoted cop looks into fake jewelry criminals, getting caught up in a risky world of bad guys, putting his life in danger as he tries to solve the case.

title: Apradhi Kaun?
desc: When a wealthy man suspected of committing a murder is mysteriously killed, the rest of the family members become suspects. Detective Rajesh Nath gets tasked with finding the culprit.
